form.label: CIM Coverage Command Center
form.description: SIEM validation view: every sourcetype a tenant sends, whether it is contracted and cataloged, and how well it is CIM-normalized. Open the "How to read this" tab for what the flags and percentages mean.

search.query: | inputlookup dc_datasets_lookup | stats first(ae_name) as ae_name by uhgid | eval index_pattern=if(uhgid="core","sec_*_core","sec_*_".uhgid), label=ae_name." (".uhgid.")" | sort ae_name

input.label: CIM coverage mode
input.choice: Fast (latest score per sourcetype, refreshed every 4h)

search.query: | `dc_cim_recon($index_filter$,$sourcetype_filter$)`

html.p: Each count is one sourcetype in one tenant index, seen in the last 7 days or listed in the contract master. Every sourcetype has exactly one status: the first unmet step, worked left to right. Complete means contracted, cataloged, CDE approved and CIM normalized.

search.query: | stats count
| where status_bucket="Complete" | stats count
| where status_bucket!="Complete" | stats count
| stats count(eval(status_bucket="Complete")) as done, count as total | eval pct=if(total=0,0,round(done/total*100,1)) | fields pct
| where status_bucket="Malformed or rejected" | stats count
| where status_bucket="Ingested, no contract" | stats count
| where status_bucket="Contract extension needed" | stats count
| where status_bucket="Contracted, no data seen" | stats count
| where status_bucket="Not yet cataloged" | stats count
| where status_bucket="Awaiting CDE approval" | stats count
| where status_bucket="CIM normalization gap" | stats count

panel.title: Status summary - who owns the next step

search.query: | stats count by bucket_order status_bucket owner next_step | eventstats sum(count) as total | eval pct_of_total=round(count/total*100,1)."%" | sort bucket_order | table status_bucket count pct_of_total owner next_step

format.colorPalette: {"Malformed or rejected":#af575a, "Ingested, no contract":#dc4e41, "Contract extension needed":#f1813f, "Contracted, no data seen":#006d9c, "Not yet cataloged":#7b56db, "Awaiting CDE approval":#708794, "CIM normalization gap":#f8be34, "Complete":#53a051}

panel.title: Progress by tenant (top 25 by sourcetypes tracked)

search.query: | eval tenant=coalesce(ae_name,uhgid) | chart count over tenant by status_bucket | addtotals fieldname=_total | sort - _total | head 25 | table tenant "Complete" "CIM normalization gap" "Awaiting CDE approval" "Not yet cataloged" "Contracted, no data seen" "Contract extension needed" "Ingested, no contract" "Malformed or rejected"

chart.option: {"Malformed or rejected":0xaf575a, "Ingested, no contract":0xdc4e41, "Contract extension needed":0xf1813f, "Contracted, no data seen":0x006d9c, "Not yet cataloged":0x7b56db, "Awaiting CDE approval":0x708794, "CIM normalization gap":0xf8be34, "Complete":0x53a051}

panel.title: Progress over time (daily snapshot from DC-102; uses the tenant filter only)

search.query: index=summary_datacatalog source="dc_cim_progress" | eval f="$index_filter$" | where f="sec_*" OR f=="sec_*_".uhgid | eval day=relative_time(_time,"@d") | eventstats max(snapshot) as last_snapshot by day | where snapshot=last_snapshot | eval _time=day | timechart span=1d sum(count) by status_bucket | table _time "Complete" "CIM normalization gap" "Awaiting CDE approval" "Not yet cataloged" "Contracted, no data seen" "Contract extension needed" "Ingested, no contract" "Malformed or rejected"

chart.option: {"Malformed or rejected":0xaf575a, "Ingested, no contract":0xdc4e41, "Contract extension needed":0xf1813f, "Contracted, no data seen":0x006d9c, "Not yet cataloged":0x7b56db, "Awaiting CDE approval":0x708794, "CIM normalization gap":0xf8be34, "Complete":0x53a051}

panel.title: Every sourcetype discovered or contracted - status: $status_filter$ (worst gaps first)

search.query: | search status_bucket="$status_filter$" | sort bucket_order - events_7d | table status_bucket owner priority ae_name index sourcetype events_7d last_seen sourcetype_check in_catalog contract contract_ticket cde_approved expected_cim cim_models_scored cim_score cim_flag gap

format.colorPalette: {"Malformed or rejected":#af575a, "Ingested, no contract":#dc4e41, "Contract extension needed":#f1813f, "Contracted, no data seen":#006d9c, "Not yet cataloged":#7b56db, "Awaiting CDE approval":#708794, "CIM normalization gap":#f8be34, "Complete":#53a051}
{"NO CIM COVERAGE":#DC4E41,"CRITICAL LOW":#DC4E41,"VERY LOW":#F1813F,"LOW":#F8BE34,"OK":#53A051,"NOT IN SCORED MODELS":#708794}

search.query: | `dc_contracts_enriched` | search index=$index_filter$ sourcetype=$sourcetype_filter$ | lookup dc_datasets_lookup uhgid OUTPUT ae_name as tenant_name | eval tenant=coalesce(mvindex(tenant_name,0), ae_name, uhgid) | lookup dc_observed_lookup dataset_id OUTPUT last_seen | eval data_last_seen=if(isnull(last_seen),"not seen",strftime(last_seen,"%Y-%m-%d")) | fields tenant uhgid index sourcetype contract_issue vendor product datamodels siem_status siem_completed cde_status days_waiting_on_cde data_last_seen
| where siem_status="SIEM complete" | stats count
| where cde_status="CDE approved" | stats count
| where siem_status="SIEM complete" AND cde_status="pending CDE" | stats count
| where isnotnull(days_waiting_on_cde) | stats median(days_waiting_on_cde) as days | eval days=round(days,0)

panel.title: Pending CDE approval by tenant and how long it has waited

search.query: | where siem_status="SIEM complete" AND cde_status="pending CDE" | eval waiting=case(days_waiting_on_cde<30,"under 30 days", days_waiting_on_cde<90,"30-89 days", 1=1,"90+ days") | chart count over tenant by waiting

panel.title: Every contract - SIEM status and CDE status, longest waiting first

search.query: | sort - days_waiting_on_cde tenant sourcetype | table tenant index sourcetype contract_issue vendor product datamodels siem_status siem_completed cde_status days_waiting_on_cde data_last_seen

panel.title: CIM field coverage scorecard (DC-101a-k, one search per data model, every 4 hours)

search.query: | inputlookup dc_cim_coverage_scorecard_lookup | search index=$index_filter$ sourcetype=$sourcetype_filter$ | `dc_drop_future_log_pairs` | eval investigation_flag=case( has_any_coverage=0,"NO CIM COVERAGE", coverage_score<20,"CRITICAL LOW", coverage_score<50,"VERY LOW", coverage_score<80,"LOW", true(),"OK") | eval checked=strftime(checked,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | table domain index sourcetype total coverage_score investigation_flag checked | sort domain coverage_score

| tstats summariesonly=true count as total from datamodel=Authentication where index=$index_filter$ sourcetype=$sourcetype_filter$ by index sourcetype | append [ | tstats summariesonly=true count as has_user from datamodel=Authentication where index=$index_filter$ sourcetype=$sourcetype_filter$ Authentication.user!="unknown" by index sourcetype ] | append [ | tstats summariesonly=true count as has_action from datamodel=Authentication where index=$index_filter$ sourcetype=$sourcetype_filter$ Authentication.action!="unknown" by index sourcetype ] | append [ | tstats summariesonly=true count as has_src from datamodel=Authentication where index=$index_filter$ sourcetype=$sourcetype_filter$ Authentication.src!="unknown" by index sourcetype ] | append [ | tstats summariesonly=true count as has_dest from datamodel=Authentication where index=$index_filter$ sourcetype=$sourcetype_filter$ Authentication.dest!="unknown" by index sourcetype ] | append [ | tstats summariesonly=true count as has_app from datamodel=Authentication where index=$index_filter$ sourcetype=$sourcetype_filter$ Authentication.app!="unknown" by index sourcetype ] | stats sum(total) as total, sum(has_user) as has_user, sum(has_action) as has_action, sum(has_src) as has_src, sum(has_dest) as has_dest, sum(has_app) as has_app by index sourcetype | `dc_drop_future_log_pairs` | eval pct_user=round(100*has_user/total,2), pct_action=round(100*has_action/total,2), pct_src=round(100*has_src/total,2), pct_dest=round(100*has_dest/total,2), pct_app=round(100*has_app/total,2) | eval coverage_score=round((pct_user*0.30)+(pct_action*0.25)+(pct_src*0.20)+(pct_dest*0.15)+(pct_app*0.10),2) | eval investigation_flag=case(coverage_score<20,"CRITICAL LOW",coverage_score<50,"VERY LOW",coverage_score<80,"LOW",true(),"OK") | table index sourcetype total pct_user pct_action pct_src pct_dest pct_app coverage_score investigation_flag | sort coverage_score

html.p: Each count is one sourcetype in one tenant index (the same sourcetype in two indexes counts twice). It covers every sourcetype seen in the last 7 days plus every sourcetype in the contract master. Each one gets exactly one status: the first step it has not passed, in the order below. So the status tiles add up to Remaining work, and Complete + Remaining = Sourcetypes tracked. Click any tile, or a row in the status summary, to list those sourcetypes on the reconciliation tab.

tr.td: The sourcetype name is raw event text, or the sourcetype was reviewed and rejected.
Data is arriving, but no contract exists for this sourcetype anywhere.
Contracted for another tenant, not this one.
A contract exists, but no data arrived in 7 days.
Contracted and flowing, but not in the data catalog.
Everything else is done; CDE has not signed off.
CIM score under 50, or expected to feed a data model it does not reach.
Contracted, cataloged, CDE approved and CIM normalized (or not expected to feed a data model).

html.p: These differ from the Catalog home page on purpose: that page counts datasets (tenant + sourcetype) in the catalog and shadow datasets seen in the last 24 hours. This page counts sourcetypes per tenant index over 7 days, against the contract master.
Progress over time is filled by DC-102, which saves the status counts once a day. It starts empty and builds from the first run.

Lists every sourcetype the tenant sent in the last 7 days, plus every sourcetype in the contract master for that tenant, so gaps show in both directions. Each row is checked against the contract master (GitHub sync, DC-37), the catalog, sourcetype rejections, and the CIM scorecard (DC-101).

tr.td: MALFORMED: the name contains raw event text or a config comment, not a real sourcetype; fix it at the source. REJECTED: reviewed and rejected; the AE should stop sending it. ok: valid name.

Two separate approvals. SIEM complete: the SIEM validation team finished the contract and notified CDE (notification_sent is true in the contract master). CDE approved: CDE has signed off (cde_approval is true); anything else is pending CDE. The "SIEM contracts and CDE" tab lists every contract with both statuses and how long it has waited on CDE.
CONTRACTED: a contract exists for this sourcetype in this tenant's index. OTHER TENANT ONLY: contracted elsewhere, not for this tenant. NO CONTRACT: data is being ingested with no contract.
Whether CDE has approved the contract (pending until the contract master says true).
The data models the contract or the catalog says this sourcetype should feed.

The best CIM field coverage score for this sourcetype (see below). NOT IN SCORED MODELS means none of its events reached the 11 data models the scorecard (DC-101a-k) covers, usually because it is not mapped to any CIM data model (or is not tagged for one).
HIGH: malformed or rejected sourcetype, or data ingested with no contract. MEDIUM: any other gap. OK: no gap.
The single most important action for the row, in priority order: sourcetype problem, no data, no contract, contract for another tenant only, not cataloged, CIM gap, awaiting CDE.

html.p: For each sourcetype in each data model, the score is the weighted percentage of its events where the model's key fields are populated (not "unknown"). 100 means every event has every key field. It measures whether fields are filled in, not whether the values are correct.
Example (Authentication): 1,000 events; user on 90%, action on 100%, src on 50%, dest on 100%, app on 0%. Score = 0.30x90 + 0.25x100 + 0.20x50 + 0.15x100 + 0.10x0 = 77, LOW.

ul.li: Fast mode shows the latest score for each sourcetype. Each data model is re-scored every 4 hours from the previous 4 hours of data; a sourcetype that goes quiet keeps its last score (see the checked column) for up to 7 days, then drops off.

Eleven data models are scored: Authentication, Alerts, Network_Traffic, Network_Sessions, Intrusion_Detection, Malware, Endpoint (Processes), Web, Change, Email, Network_Resolution (DNS). Others (for example DLP or Vulnerabilities) are not.
